name: Light split hero

variant.note: pst-stones = two sibling .shape-contain blobs (/parents, /sitters, /trust-safety). shape-stack = .header-shapes-contain with cc-sitters-top + cc-sitters-bottom (/faq, /careers). image-square = a 1:1 .u-img-cover photo (/contact). bare-image = an unwrapped width-limited img with the section's padding zeroed by .u-p-0 (/blog).

heading.measuredLongestRealInstance: "Making the impossible things about kidcare possible" = 7 words

headingWeightQuirk.note: true when the h1 carries .u-mb-0, which also declares font-weight:400 — so the h1 computes Reckless Neue 400 while only the 900 Heavy file is hosted and the browser synthesises a lighter face. Observed true on /sitters, /careers, /contact and /blog; false on /trust-safety, /faq and /parents. INTENTIONAL — this is the original's correct appearance.

lede.note: Absent on /faq, which has a heading only.

ledeClass.note: /trust-safety uses .paragraph-1-5, which is text-align:center with margin-bottom:24px even inside this left-aligned hero. Reproduced as measured.

href.note: Only two CTA targets are observed on light heroes: the app-host welcome path (subpages use /sign-up/welcome, NOT the bare /sign-up the homepage uses) and the /careers same-page #jobs anchor.

ctas.note: 0 on /faq and /blog, 1 on /parents, /sitters and /careers, 2 on /trust-safety (wrapped in .buttons-wrapper).

heroImage.note: Only for the image-square and bare-image variants. /contact's hero image is display:none at <=767 via .col-sm-hide, so it is absent at 390.

constraints.note: The homepage uses hero.dark-rounded instead. Every other marketing route with a hero uses this one. /blog-posts/:slug, /terms-of-use, /privacy-policy and /log-in have NO hero at all — see compatibility/graph.json NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.

motion.note: No entrance or scroll animation. CSS hover transitions on .btn (colour trio, 300ms ease.outQuart) are global chrome behaviour, not section motion.

responsive.desktop: copy column (col-lg-5 or col-lg-6) and a shape/image column inside .container.cc-narrow with row-justify-between + row-align-center. Section padding 80px 0. Section header gap 24px.
responsive.le991: columns narrow with the percentage container; still side by side at 1024 (1024 > 991).
responsive.le767: columns collapse per their col-sm-* spans. /contact's hero image disappears (.col-sm-hide).
responsive.le479: everything stacks (.col becomes flex-basis 100%). Section padding 48px 0, header gap 16px. /careers' bottom blob reflows below the top one.

notes: The three PST routes share one hero skeleton; only copy, CTA count and shape fills differ.
/parents and /careers rotate their bottom blob 90deg (computed matrix(0,1,-1,0,0,0)).
